text:
Stop confusing your dopamine addiction with being alive.

That rush isn't freedom. It's just withdrawal avoidance. Your brain hijacked by a chemical loop.

Every hit weakens will. Clouds the mind. Steals creative edge. A s*x addicted man and a junkie are twins. Just different drugs.

Your s*x energy isn't the problem. Wasting it is.

Treat it like capital. Spend it on cheap dopamine hits and you're broke. Invest it into your work, your body, your mission and it multiplies into power.

The only capital you cannot lose is discipline.
caption:
Discipline is the only capital that always compounds.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
